title: Order of Application for a Late Month's Payments — Apartment Home Lease Resident Terms
content:
The order in which a late rent month's payments on an Apartment Home Lease are applied, when a catch-up amount is worked out, follows the lease's standing:

(a) a lease with no returned payment in the last 12 months and at least one renewal rent change recorded on its Lease Term Agreements applies them to the period's rent first, then to its late fees, then to its recurring fees;

(b) a lease with no returned payment in the last 12 months and no renewal rent change applies them to its recurring fees first, then to its rent, then to its late fees;

(c) any other lease applies them in the charter order: recurring fees first, then late fees, then rent — and in a Colorado community rent first, then recurring fees, then late fees.

## Terms used

- **Returned payment in the last 12 months** — any payment return on the lease ledger dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the handling date, whatever its reason.
- **Renewal rent change** — a rent change recorded with a renewal as its reason on the Lease Term Agreements of the lease.
- **Applied in an order** — each part in turn takes the payments up to its own amount before the remainder passes to the next part.

## Standing table

| Payment return dated in the last 12 months | Renewal rent change on the Lease Term Agreements | Order of application |
|---|---|---|
| No | 1 or more | rent, late fees, recurring fees |
| No | none | recurring fees, rent, late fees |
| Yes | any | recurring fees, late fees, rent (Colorado: rent, recurring fees, late fees) |

## Hypothetical split

Period lines: rent $1,800.00, recurring fees $94.00, late fees $130.00; period payments $1,000.00; community outside Colorado.

| Standing | Rent still unpaid | Recurring fees still unpaid | Late fees still unpaid |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) | $800.00 | $94.00 | $130.00 |
| (b) | $894.00 | $0.00 | $130.00 |
| (c) | $1,024.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
